title: Oozing Caramelized Russian Honey Bake
description: A malty, gooey Russian dish featuring cayenne pepper, perfect for a romantic evening. Salt-bake adds a unique crust to the iron teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan vessel in a salt-bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together Russo-Oats Flour, Dark Brown Sugar, and Malted Milk Powder.
Add Honey, Eggs, Cayenne Pepper, and Salt to the bowl; mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into the preheated iron teppan vessel.
Evenly spread the Unsalted Butter on top of the mixture.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the bake from the vessel.
Invert the bake onto a serving plate and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Slice the bake into 8-10 pieces and serve warm.
